pack_id: P5-FOUR-PLANE-HISTORIES — Arcavios, Vryn, Serra's Realm, Regatha
scope: Twelve directly cited plane claims from five Wizards pages. The source-era geography, founding accounts, faction disputes and past fates are not a complete chronology or proof of current political status.

fph_origins_2015.title: The Worlds of Magic Origins
fph_origins_2015.perspective: Wizards 2015 description of Vryn's Core States conflict

fph_multiverse_2008.title: The Known Multiverse
fph_multiverse_2008.perspective: Wizards 2008 retrospective of Serra's Realm; historically situated

fph_original_spin_2015.title: Original Spin
fph_original_spin_2015.perspective: Wizards design article identifying Jaya as founder of the Regathan monastery

fph_offers_fire_2015.title: Offers to the Fire
fph_offers_fire_2015.perspective: 2015 Keral Keep scene on Regatha, not a contemporary geographic survey

claims.subject: arcavios
claims.source_excerpt: At the birth of the plane, as the mana of two planes overlapped in conflicting ways
claims.summary: The 2021 guide describes Arcavios's birth amid the overlapping mana of two planes.
claims.limitation: A source's origin account, not an identified pair of parent planes, a mechanism of planar fusion, or a dated universal chronology.

claims.subject: arcavios
claims.source_excerpt: Five particularly powerful vortices of overlapping mana became luminous spheres, from which were hatched five dragons.
claims.summary: Five founder dragons hatched from luminous mana vortices during Arcavios's early history.
claims.limitation: The guide presents the dragons' origin on Arcavios, not their current locations, a complete dragon genealogy or their exact age in AR years.

claims.subject: arcavios
claims.source_excerpt: Founded some 700 years ago by five spellcasting dragons, Strixhaven University is Arcavios's premier institution of magical learning
claims.summary: The five dragons founded Strixhaven University on Arcavios roughly seven centuries before the guide's era.
claims.limitation: Seven centuries is relative to the guide's narrative viewpoint; it is not converted into a fixed in-universe calendar date or a claim about the university today.

claims.subject: vryn
claims.source_excerpt: Vryn's most salient feature is its network of mage-rings, enormous structures that channel mana from the outlying areas to the politically powerful Core States.
claims.summary: Vryn's mage-ring network routes mana from outlying regions toward its Core States.
claims.limitation: Wizards explicitly says the rings' age and origin are unknown; this 2015 account does not settle their builders or current operating condition.

claims.subject: vryn
claims.source_excerpt: The Ampryn League, also called the Ampryn Core or the Core States, is the ascendant faction on Vryn.
claims.summary: In the Origins-era profile, the Ampryn League holds ascendant political power on Vryn.
claims.limitation: Ascendance describes the profile's depicted period, not a verified everlasting government or the result of the Vryn factional conflict.

claims.subject: vryn
claims.source_excerpt: The Trovian Separatists are the rebel faction on Vryn.
claims.summary: The Trovian Separatists opposed Ampryn control, contesting strings of Vryn's mage-rings.
claims.limitation: This is the 2015 profile's political conflict; it neither identifies a final victor nor proves the separatists' present status.

claims.subject: serras_realm
claims.source_excerpt: But the Phyrexians found the realm and attacked, tainting it with black mana.
claims.summary: Phyrexian pursuers invaded and corrupted Serra's Realm after Urza took refuge there.
claims.limitation: The article is a retrospective of the original realm; it does not imply the realm survived as a functioning modern plane.

claims.subject: serras_realm
claims.source_excerpt: One of her archangels, Radiant, assumed control of the plane in Serra's absence.
claims.summary: The archangel Radiant assumed authority over Serra's Realm after Serra departed.
claims.limitation: A historical succession amid corruption and collapse, not a claim that Radiant remained ruler after the realm's destruction.

claims.subject: serras_realm
claims.source_excerpt: hastened its demise by forcibly collapsing the plane's energies into a powerstone
claims.summary: Urza collapsed Serra's Realm into the powerstone used by the Weatherlight's planeswalking engine.
claims.limitation: The realm was already collapsing; the source does not claim Urza alone caused its initial corruption or give a precise date for the finale.

claims.subject: regatha
claims.source_excerpt: the monastery on Regatha that Chandra ends up at was founded by none other than Jaya Ballard
claims.summary: Wizards identifies Jaya Ballard as the founder of the Regathan monastery later attended by Chandra.
claims.limitation: The developer commentary identifies the founder but does not provide an absolute founding date or establish Jaya's current identity or whereabouts.

claims.subject: regatha
claims.source_excerpt: Chandra and the monastery's fire monks balanced on floes of solid rock in the lava field, miles from the Keral Keep monastery on Regatha.
claims.summary: Keral Keep is a monastery on Regatha, with fire-monk training in nearby lava fields.
claims.limitation: A location and training scene from the 2015 story, not a complete geographic survey or proof of its safety and occupancy at later dates.

claims.subject: regatha
claims.source_excerpt: Some of Jaya's spells had become ritualized exercises that the fire acolytes practiced
claims.summary: Keral Keep's fire acolytes ritualized some of Jaya's spells as part of their teachings.
claims.limitation: This reports a practiced monastic tradition at Keral Keep, not the full origin of Regathan pyromancy or a current curriculum guarantee.

remaining: Do not infer which two planes supplied Arcavios's overlapping mana or convert '700 years' into AR chronology.
Vryn's mage-ring builders, ages and outcome of the Core States conflict remain unresolved.
Serra's Realm's Phyrexian corruption, Radiant period and final powerstone collapse are past, not current rulership.
Regatha's monastic tradition and Keral Keep scene do not establish a plane-wide religion or its current condition.
No deckbuilding, owner approval or foundation release follows from this research.
